- Net.Amount: from table "1.174,50" -> convert to numeric with same decimals: 1174.50.
- Vat.Amount: from table "117,45" -> convert to numeric: 117.45.

6) Verify No Inference / maintain decimals:
- All extracted values come directly from visible fields; no guessing involved. Decimals preserved (two decimals).

7) Prepare for final JSON:
- Fields to populate: GrandTotal.Amount = 1291.95; Invoice.Date = "11.10.2023"; Sender.VatId = "ATU39103108"; Vat.Rate = 10; Net.Amount = 1174.50; Vat.Amount = 117.45.
